verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms Nitrokey 3 supports FIDO2 and ships an official CLI (nitropy). However, nothing documents listing or deleting resident passkeys, or reporting remaining credential capacity. A CLI that interacts with devices is a building block, not evidence of this capability, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power user, I can list and delete the passkeys stored on my key and know its credential capacity before it fills up
